name: Melo unrestricted mint sold into USDT liquidity
summary: MEL exposed mint(address,uint256,string) without authorization or supply limits. Callers minted arbitrary balances and sold them into the MEL/USDT pair, depleting its USDT. The initial transaction and later repetitions exercise the same immutable token defect.

loss.notes: Merged 31 mint-and-sale transactions through 2025-10-11, including later actors repeating the same fault. USDT proceeds value the fabricated MEL at disposal, with USDT at $1. Subtract 0.000000062597217262 USDT supplied by a later exploiter to the pair; ordinary token purchases and sales are excluded. No recovery or financing-fee deduction.

sources.note: Reviewed anchor, root cause, merged loss and complete target age history. Etherscan V2 getsourcecode for MEL (https://bscscan.com/address/0x9a1aef8c9ada4224ad774afdac07c24955c92a54#code) identifies cERC20: public mint invokes _mint without authorization; only balances, allowances, supply and immutable-in-practice metadata are stored. There is no upgrade, external call, SELFDESTRUCT or configuration setter. Source-5 receipt establishes direct creation by the recorded creator. eth_getCode at blocks 27947265 and 27960445 is byte-identical and hashes to codeArtifact.codeHash. Source-1 callTracer invokes mint selector 0xd3fc9864; Transfer log 71 creates 146965900.2021899513963488 MEL, log 74 transfers it to pair 0x6a8c4448763c08adeb80adebf7a29b9477fa0628, and USDT log 76 pays 90488.670389646322334139 to the attacker. This corrects the seed claim of arbitrary pair-token removal. First-use scan: eth_getLogs for MEL Transfer from zero over [27947265,124482922] finds only constructor issuance before source-1; all 3079 MEL Transfer logs through that upper bound were checked. Etherscan V2 account/tokentx for USDT at the pair, startblock=27947265,endblock=124482922,sort=asc,page=1,offset=10000 returns 181 entries, including 38 pair outflows at/after source-1. Reproduced their receipts and callTracer traces. Source-6 lists the 31 outflows funded by unauthorized mints, totaling 92338.994363420236700433 USDT; subtract the 0.000000062597217262 USDT input in 0xd3198b4888e9464945b05a6aee0fe3894e8899cabb288f33945a01c280617e26. Seven other outflows are ordinary resale of purchased MEL: sellers 0x00000000001f8b68515efb546542397d3293ccfd (two), 0x0000000000f92b9350f41fa6cd93be16ff7649db, 0xb8e02d517b733541df04c7404864546e21e50df4, 0xaaf89b4ecae9d843446ffd316dbdfee69fb0ed5e and 0xcde689f011340b7152df4eacbb38ef823348711e (two; received from buyer 0x509cbb19b4bc8ede5e36a2fe0ff7a053092e3ba2), and are excluded. Separate-transaction mint provenance is supplied by source-7. USDT has 18 decimals. Sum USDT Transfer amounts from the pair in source-6 minus its campaign input to reproduce loss; do not count onward transfers again. Later actors minting into this same runtime are merged, not new knots; final loss is block 64193011. Coverage is bounded at block 124482922 (2026-09-28); future repetitions require updating this record.

limitations: Campaign scan ends at BNB Chain block 124482922; the immutable mint defect remains callable, so later losses would extend this episode.
